_doc: Who every session is. One row per session, chat or runner pool. A session finds its row by name and loads role_skill. No row: it reports 'not in roster' to Fleet Tools and takes no work. kind: chief, lead, view-lead, solo-dev, runner-pool, specialist, outside, closed. status measured 2026-11-07 14:00 UTC from tmux and process lists; Multibot chats are 'unknown' until mp-layout list exists (multiprompt PRs 834, 850). Source of decisions: YPER4-1371. Sessions announce themselves at start with fleet/roster-announce (HYCI-214); announcements live in ~/.local/state/roster/announce/, never in this file. Solo-dev rows may carry board without view (client board, whole board), view as a scopes.json key or a raw view id, client, harness and take (section: 0 in flight, 1 queue).
